tasks.title: Conversation #86
tasks.transcript:
Man: Are you planning to the cooking demonstration at the food festival this weekend?
Woman: Yes, I heard the instructor is very well-known throughout the world and will be showing how to make some delicious recipes.
Man: That sounds great. Do you know what time it starts?
Woman: It starts at 11 AM. I'll be there early to get a good spot.
Man: Perfect. I'll see you there.

questions.stem: What event are the speakers discussing?
questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：说话者在讨论什么活动？ 定位原文：Man: Are you planning to go to the cooking demonstration at the food festival this weekend? 选项分析： A. A music concert 音乐会。对话中未提及音乐或演唱会，所以A选项错误。 B. A cooking demonstration 烹饪演示。男士明确提到“cooking demonstration”，所以B选项正确。 C. A book signing 签售会。对话中未提及书籍或签售，所以C选项错误。 D. An art exhibit 艺术展。对话中未提及艺术展览，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What does the woman say about the instructor?

options.C: He is new to the area.

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：女士对 instructor 有什么评价？ 定位原文：Woman: Yes, I heard the instructor is very well-known throughout the world... 选项分析： A. He is famous. 他很有名。女士说 instructor 是“very well-known throughout the world”，即世界闻名，所以A选项正确。 B. He is fantastic. 他非常棒。女士没有直接评价其能力或表现，所以B选项错误。 C. He is new to the area. 他是新来这个地区的。对话中未提到地域迁移，所以C选项错误。 D. He is her friend. 他是她的朋友。女士只说听说他很出名，并未称其为朋友，所以D选项错误。
